question: What is the state of the art system mentioned?

answer.free_form_answer:
Two knowledge-based systems,
two traditional word expert supervised systems, six recent neural-based systems, and one BERT feature-based system.

title: GlossBERT: BERT for Word Sense Disambiguation with Gloss Knowledge
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents repeatedly mention that the state-of-the-art system is achieved by fine-tuning the pre-trained BERT model, as stated in Text 1, Text 2, Text 3, and Text 4. These texts explicitly reference BERT as the model used to achieve new state-of-the-art results on the WSD task.
